description: The Invoices, Quotes and Reverses pages: customer invoices (default), quotes (documentKind=quote) or credit notes (documentKind=credit_note), newest first, with status, customer, the sales order billed, dates, total and whether an issued invoice is paid or overdue. Filter by status, customer, sales order or search text. Call get_invoice for a document's lines and payments.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: only documents that bill that client's sales orders.

salesOrderId.description: Optional sales order id (GUID): documents that bill that order.

search.description: Search text: document number, customer name or sales order number.

status.description: all (default), draft (not yet issued), issued, paid, unpaid (issued, no payment), overdue (unpaid past due), canceled; for quotes open, accepted, converted or canceled.

name: list_invoices
title: List Invoices
